# Storage accounting instantiation

Scope: storage only, M=2, base frozen. Source claim storage_accounting in blueprint.yaml includes all storage events and finance corrections. Never read another scenario or sibling task artifacts. Identifier band +12025550120..139, 20000000..29999999, d2- email prefix.

Task 0 thesis: correct one cool-storage invoice now. Silent prerequisite chain: reconcile shared retained-capacity entitlement -> establish corrected source-line review -> post correction credit. All three parameters use source-specific history, tier policy, and numeric read-only backup entitlement. The extended charter will explicitly replace the ancillary allowance handling sentence; no base edits. Financial amounts remain source-line scoped and tax treatment approved. Tools perform atomic CRUD, with no prerequisite guard. Several storage holdings distinguish scopes; ten completed source exports and the prior capacity-allocation record support history; no exact-source correction credit or debit exists at opening.

Occupied before task 0: nothing. Task 0 claims supplemental retained-capacity billing correction. Remaining task 1 will claim outage-service-credit and customer fund disposal, a separate business policy core with a >=4 synchronous-write workflow and a real customer-owned authorization. The task 1 workflow is not authored before task 0 closes.

Base invariant review: storage_service_record inherits category-meter policy; storage_review inherits exact source/evidence correlation and nonfinancial review semantics; storage_credit inherits approved tax evidence, conditional approved correction review and conditional approved service-credit review. Conditional gates must be documented as inapplicable when another subtype is used, rather than accidentally treating a billing credit as an outage claim. No suspension/collection/exit obligation is triggered by task 0. Existing review evidence fields are awkwardly generalized; bind each required value to its specific authoritative source field and preserve the exact charge and review references in writes.

Capability cards planned: agent records one quantified nonfinancial retained-capacity entitlement (receipt identifies event and quantity); agent writes one corrected nonfinancial billing review (receipt identifies review and target net); agent posts one source-linked signed correction credit (receipt identifies financial event and amount). Numeric calculations remain outside tool bodies; all sources queryable at opening or after a synchronous preceding write.

Task 0 checkpoint: EXTENDED OK; TASK TOOL CONTRACT OK; REPLAY OK (11 actions, 21 closure/seed rows, deterministic and nonvacuous, 0 errors); SOLVABILITY OK (3 writes, 6 gates); COMPUTE OK (25 factors, 30 historical touches, 14 branches); GROUNDING OK; SCOPE OK. Published-KB traceability deferred until render.

Manual values review task 0: depth is entitlement -> review -> credit, two value-input edges. Breadth is ten source export slices, prior allocation, the charge's own billing period, same-entity active backup commitment, clear versus restricted branch and approved untaxed basis. Completed zero-quantity prior capacity record carries 1000 GB-month already consumed. Entitlement writes 4000; review writes 74.40; credit writes -49.60. Skips recomputed independently in verify0.py: missing entitlement produces review 124 and credit zero; missing review produces credit -62. Tools have no guards and still write if prerequisites are absent. Source object is now obtained through the holding's actual authorization request, whose source_event_id is the invoice; the holding request_id is not misused as a charge id. August-specific draft wording was generalized to the source invoice period without changing values. The root remains a financial correction, never an implicit cash refund. Service-credit gate is conditional and inapplicable to correction subtype. No active time gate is inherited here. Existing source exports and approval suffice for immediate accountant review; no external approval/physical event waits. Persona closes on the agent's correction-posted announcement and supplies no prerequisite names. Visible-prose draft recomputation gives 10000 - min(5000-1000,10000)=6000 billable GB-month, 6000*0.0124=74.40, and -(124-74.40)=-49.60. Tool/name/parameter and rationale propagation checked.

Task 1 claim: disjoint outage service-credit and refund disposal, with one five-write workflow: customer claim, accountant eligibility assessment, financial concession, customer refund authorization, cash refund. These are synchronous accounting and authorization actions against a completed incident and a settled bank receipt present at opening. The user asks only for the excess money back; policy reveals incident claim and concession prerequisites. Customer-owned claim and exact refund authorization require explicit handover and confirmation, never the agent impersonating the customer. Numeric support/backup combination refines the service credit ceiling by explicitly replacing its base amount clause; source linkage, original tax, incident exclusion and timely claim requirements remain inherited. Task 0 is now occupied; no remaining task after task 1.

Task 1 per-task checkpoint: EXTENDED OK; TASK TOOL CONTRACT OK (8 total tools); REPLAY OK (15 actions, deterministic, nonvacuous, zero errors); SOLVABILITY OK (5 writes and 10 inherited gates); COMPUTE OK (five computations, 69 factors before principal refinement, 38 historical touches and 45 branches); GROUNDING OK; SCOPE OK.

Task 1 manual gates and revision: original payment principal must be scoped to the requested source invoice, not all historical remittances. Refined principal to the one source-linked payment less only refunds/returns linked to that payment. Added the three older primary meter export sources and their actual month boundaries so settled historical invoices do not teach a contradictory service period. No numerical output changed. Removed an unused prior-credit intermediate from the two refund computations; incident cause now expressly excludes non-provider cases. Replaced a minimum that could silently reduce an excessive authorization with an explicit authorization-within-available branch: excessive or subminimum authorizations yield no payout. The accountant review's caller-limited partial entitlement is explicitly declared as a clause override. A workflow approval link is represented by the actual approved assessment identifier, not an inaccurate claim to flip the correction-subtype gate for a service-credit posting.

Task 1 values after all refinements: original net 1000, availability 98, SLA band .20, support portfolio_discount .035, combined fraction .235, total ceiling235, prior concession20, new claim215, assessment215, financial credit-215. Initial target cash credit20 becomes235 after concession; original-payment remaining principal1000 supports235; authorization235 permits payout235. Removing the support holding lowers the total ceiling to200 and changes every relevant computation. Omitting claim or assessment yields zero new concession; omitting concession leaves authorization20; omitting authorization yields payout0. No prerequisite tool guards or hints exist.

Time/authority audit: official incident closed 2026-09-04T12:00:00Z. Adding the tier's 30 UTC calendar dates gives 2026-10-04T12:00:00Z. The claim at frozen 2026-09-12T11:00:00Z is timely. Exactly the deadline qualifies; one second later does not. The refund authorization is subtype refund and therefore does not itself incur a service-credit deadline; its inherited conditional gate is inapplicable, with the incident evidence still supplied. The original ACH receipt is posted before opening, not customer-promised. The incident report is completed before opening; the accountant computes a determination from it on the spot, without claiming to perform operations or await external approval.

Zero-wait cards: (0) claim consumes initial invoice/incident and current personal consent; synchronous filing records notice and exact amount. (1) assessment consumes preceding actual claim and existing report; accountant performs the numeric decision, not a fabricated external diagnosis. (2) concession consumes approved assessment identifier and books signed receivable delta synchronously. (3) customer sees resulting amount and original ACH destination and personally submits exact authorization; the new concession identifier is from the real previous return. (4) refund consumes the exact posted authorization and original confirmed payment, returning cash through that recorded original destination. Each source_kind is initial_state_preexisting, prior_synchronous_tool_effect or current_user_input; one frozen clock suffices.

Visible-prose draft recomputation: after masking machine compute, expected and GT, the source ledger and published-rule draft yield (0.20+0.035)*1000=235 total allowance, less20 already credited=215 now; sum of historical paired charges/payments is zero, current original1000 plus payment-1000 plus credits-235 yields credit balance235; authorize and pay235. The ordinary base 200 ceiling is not called erroneous; the exact sentence establishing it is replaced in the extended version. Persona mentions only the requested excess-money return, not the incident or hidden concession chain. It confirms displayed forms only after handover and ends on the refund announcement even if the agent erred. Both genuine customer-owned filings are required, not agent consent proxies.

Combined scope review: task0 alone owns shared-capacity billing correction; task1 alone owns outage concession and original-payment refund. Eight policies and eight tools are all claimed; exactly one five-write workflow is fully exercised. Every computation has an exercised numeric cross-category input. No blueprint artifact was edited. No further product policy or spare tool is reserved.


Final full suite passed, complete stdout/stderr and return codes in gate_outputs.txt. Final REPLAY: task0 21/21 closure rows; task1 23/23; both deterministic, nonvacuous, 0 errors. COMPUTE task0 factors25/history30/branches14/steps11; task1 factors67/history38/branches47/steps15; suite means46/30.5/13. Traceability intentionally deferred to published-KB rendering. Authoring scripts removed; verify0.py and verify1.py remain independently runnable with verification_refs0.json and verification_refs1.json.

Final base-compatibility sweep found that support combination's channel-only prose also needed an explicit clause override. Added both exact combination restrictions to each outage policy overwrite, keeping approval authority and primary prices unchanged; this changes no computation, tool, seed or GT value.

## Source audit rework round 2

Input: every file in audits/policy_task/storage_accounting/ was read, including both task reports, charter-global report, freeze manifest and executable authorization counterexample evidence. The audit confirms all numeric values, source histories, graph edges and zero-wait semantics except the three findings below. Preserve those passed dimensions.

T0-1: ACCEPTED. The early thesis incorrectly says past exact-source corrections exist. The actual source has zero correction credits/debits; history difficulty comes from ten completed source exports and a prior capacity allocation. Replace the assertion everywhere it was embedded, without changing the seed or arithmetic.

P1 / T1-1: ACCEPTED. Add an exact clause override for storage_evt_request's filing lifecycle to both customer-filing policies. In this immediate procedure posted denotes submitted customer intent, not system approval; filing sets both notice_at and occurred_at to the frozen clock. Cancellation remains a separate cancelled request linked to the original. Both actual tools will write both times; no prerequisite guard is added.

T1-2: ACCEPTED. The refund tool's unused generic storage_event_id admits both incident and payment evidence. Give that argument a single business meaning: the selected refund authorization identifier, equal to the request_id stored on it; use it as the actual update target. The original payment remains source_event_id, and the actual concession remains related_event_id. Update source rule, runtime schema, GT, argument tracing, solvability evidence and verification together. The refund request subtype does not acquire an outage deadline merely because its category shares a conditional deadline contract.

Round 2 item closure:

- T0-1 CLOSED: removed the unsupported correction-history assertion from the worklog and both copied task dossiers. Task 0 still has zero prior correction credits/debits; its ten exports and prior capacity allocation remain the actual history. No task 0 policy, tool, seed or scored action changed.
- P1 / T1-1 CLOSED: storage_ext_outage_claim and storage_ext_outage_authorize now quote the exact storage_evt_request filing sentence in overwrite and replace it with submitted-intent status posted plus notice_at and occurred_at from the frozen clock; cancellation behavior remains inherited explicitly. Both user functions now perform that exact atomic update. Both solvability policy_scope entries cite the effective replacement instead of falsely asserting the pending-state sentence. The positive real-tool verification asserts both filed records have status posted and notice_at=occurred_at="2026-09-12 11:00:00 UTC", exactly the frozen clock string returned by ctx.now(). The opening September 5 occurrence remains only the draft's historical value until filing; initial_state was not falsified.
- T1-2 CLOSED: authorize_storage_refund.storage_event_id is the target refund-authorization identifier and is used by ctx.update. Its docstring and policy exclusively require the selected pending refund request's storage_event_id for both storage_event_id and request_id. Gold step12 now supplies 89e76b3c-1312-4bbc-a5da-d3368beb4549 for both. Original payment8a89f81c-a582-47d2-a565-af8700533956 remains source_event_id; actual preceding concession remains related_event_id. An incident or payment cannot meet the affirmative authorization-identifier contract. No tool rejects a prerequisite or computes business arithmetic. The conditional service-credit deadline is explicitly marked inapplicable to this refund form; it supplies no incident-valued argument requirement.

Propagation and verification: source policy, exact overrides, runtime docstrings/effects, GT step12 and its argument tracing, solvability evidence/bindings, verifier and embedded latest dossiers updated together. The first solvability rerun caught a replaced field locator missing from its evidence list; added that exact authorization locator and the rerun passed. verify1.py now includes filed_record snapshots and positive runtime assertions for both timestamps and the authorization update target. Its normal amounts remain215,215,-215,235,235; all four omission sensitivity results are unchanged. Actual replay remains deterministic/nonvacuous with zero errors and closures21/21 and23/23. No audit files or blueprint assets were changed. No temporary authoring script was created.

Later review and credit use that recorded notice_at to evaluate the same boundary, so a timely request does not expire while awaiting review. Multiply the original source charge net_amount by that fraction; subtract the service_credit_net component of prior credits for that exact source, and cap total service credits at credit_cap_fraction of that original net amount. Floor the additional credit at zero and round with amount_precision and rounding_mode. Apply the original tax component proportionately. A review writes its nonnegative approved result; a financial credit writes the negative approved amount only after that approved review exists. This service-credit branch applies only to source_subtype service_credit; evt_correction applies only to source_subtype correction.
